role: @Observable holder of streaming-mode and pause/resume state split out of RRCollector so views observing it do not re-render on unrelated collector changes, and of the one-caller claim on ending an overnight session; injected into the SwiftUI environment and read by Record views.
toplevel: Seven observable stored properties with default initialisers, plus isEndingOvernight (private(set)), set and cleared only through claimOvernightEnding/releaseOvernightEnding by the overnight Stop, Pause and Discard. Owned by RRCollector (RRCollector.swift:187, created at 703) and read through @Environment(StreamingLifecycle.self) in RecordView and passed to StreamingLiveView/RecordingStatusViews/RecordPanels.

units.does: Claims the ending of the overnight session for the caller: false when no night is streaming or another caller already holds the ending; otherwise sets isEndingOvernight and returns true.

branches.cond: not overnight streaming, or an ending already claimed

units.does: Ends a claimed ending: clears isEndingOvernight.
